decision_statement: Launch an open procedure for the preventive and corrective maintenance of the 420 light vehicles of the fleet, 36 months, estimated at 1,140,000 EUR excl. VAT (905 EUR per vehicle per year), against a current spend of 1,410,000 EUR over the last 36 months.
context_at_decision: The current contract (2023-2026) ends on 2026-09-30. Spend over its 36 months: 1,410,000 EUR, 1,119 EUR per vehicle per year. The fleet office's assistant compared it with 14 contracts of the same object and size published in the essential procurement data (DECP) 2024-2025: median 890 EUR per vehicle per year, first quartile 760, third quartile 1,010. The assistant's estimate for this fleet: 905 EUR, given the share of utility vehicles (38 %).
options_considered: Open procedure, one lot, 36 months, estimate 1,140,000 EUR (chosen): the comparables show a market price about 20 % below the current spend; a single lot keeps one accountable maintainer per vehicle.
Renew with the current holder by negotiated procedure: not available at this amount, and the price is the problem.

Join the departmental purchasing group's maintenance contract: 940 EUR per vehicle per year in its 2025 price list, but a 48-month commitment and no utility-vehicle rate; kept as the fallback if the procedure fails.
Two lots (passenger cars, utility vehicles): would let specialists bid, but doubles the management; revisit at the next renewal with this contract's data.
required_inputs_used: Spend ledger 2023-2026 of the current contract (1,410,000 EUR, 1,119 EUR per vehicle per year)
DECP extract 2024-2025, 14 comparable contracts (median 890, Q1 760, Q3 1,010 EUR per vehicle per year)
assumptions_depended_on: The fleet stays within 400 to 440 vehicles over 36 months.
The comparables' scope (preventive and corrective, parts included) matches this need.
success_criteria: Awarded price at or below 1,140,000 EUR over 36 months (905 EUR per vehicle per year).
Actual spend at 12 months at or below 390,000 EUR, measured on the invoice ledger.
Vehicle availability at or above 96 %, measured monthly by the fleet office.

affirmation_record.method: signed approval in the procurement console

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-METROPOLE-ACHATS-2026: the purchasing assistant (achats-assistant, version 2) drafted the estimate from the spend ledger and the DECP comparables; I reviewed the four options recorded here, chose the open procedure, and I am the accountable owner of this decision in my capacity as an employee of the Métropole.

re_decision_trigger: No offer at or below the estimate; or a fleet change beyond 10 %; or the 12-month review.
